name: Ticket Brief
description: Reads a district support ticket and writes a short summary of the problem, the ask, and any student-data details the agent should not miss.
cost: Included with the support desk. No extra license.

name: Huddle Notes
description: Turns a recording of an internal staff meeting into notes, decisions, and owners.

name: Family Language Desk
description: Translates parent letters, attendance notices, and portal messages between English and the languages a district requests.

name: Reply Macro Shelf
description: Shared library of approved reply macros for common district questions about enrollment, records, and family notices.
cost: No license. Support leads edit the shelf.

name: Roster Dedupe
description: Script that finds duplicate student rows in a roster spreadsheet and writes a cleaned copy beside the original.
cost: Runs on an analyst laptop. No license fee.

name: Consent Ledger
description: Tracks which families have returned a data-sharing consent form and which forms are still outstanding.

name: Ticket Stamp
description: Retired tool that stamped each support ticket with a category. Replaced by the current desk workflow. Do not route new tickets here.

name: Letter Merge Classic
description: Old mail-merge that filled parent letters from a spreadsheet. Kept for reference only. Do not use it for new sends.
cost: Unused legacy seat at $200 a year

name: Break Room Snack Count
description: Counts snacks in the office kitchen and flags when someone should reorder.
cost: A shared spreadsheet. No software cost.

name: Lobby Plant Chart
description: Watering schedule and pot list for the plants in the lobby.
cost: A paper chart. No software cost.
